role: Deliberately induces creative divergence via a fixed 7-chamber sequence (Pantheon, Beast, Mythic, Trickster, Mirror, Temporal, Ethos Core) — real, intentional use of LLM hallucination for ideation, never for facts. Same harm/injection safety checks as E-01 still apply; 'go wild creatively' is never license to skip them. Output feeds directly into E-01's real groundConcept() mode.
behaviorDescription: dream() runs the same real harm/injection scans as E-01, then always assembles the full fixed 7-chamber prompt in order — no selection logic, unlike E-01's pantheon (every chamber runs every time, by design). checkOutput() validates a completed DreamerOutput's real structure: mutation paths must genuinely number 3-5, danger score must genuinely be 1-10, every chamber field must have real content. No LLM call needed for validation or prompt assembly — the actual hallucinated content itself needs a live LLM, same honest limitation as every generation-shaped employee.
hardStops: Never skips the harm/injection safety scan — deliberate creative divergence is not license to bypass safety
Never generates the actual hallucinated content itself — assembles the validated 7-chamber prompt only
Never treats an out-of-range danger score or wrong mutation-path count as valid — real structural validation, not a formality
